title: Retrospective Harness Optimization: Improving LLM Agents via Self-Preference over Trajectory Rollouts

To address this problem, we introduce Retrospective Harness Optimization (RHO), a self-supervised method that optimizes the agent harness using only past trajectories. Spe…
